name: EF Core Migration & Schema Drift Validator
description: Verifies Entity Framework Core migrations for destructive schema changes, column drops, lock contention, and zero-downtime deployment compatibility (expand/contract pattern).

migrationFilePath.description: Path to the C# EF Core Migration file (*.Designer.cs or *.cs).

allowDestructiveChanges.description: Whether breaking changes like dropping non-empty tables or columns are permitted.
